name: Tanning
overview: The Scriptures mention tanning in the context of Simon, a tanner in Joppa, with whom the apostle Peter stayed during important moments of divine instruction and mission (Acts 9:43; 10:5-6). This setting highlights the practical, everyday backdrop of early Christian ministry, where God used ordinary professions and places to advance His redemptive plan. The presence of Simon the tanner by the seaside also underscores the intersection of faith with daily labor and community life.
